messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Retain the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action in the same environment. Only change how the camera captures the scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She faces the camera, then turns her head and body to the side, raises her hand to touch her hair, and turns back to face forward.","camera":"A static, eye-level medium close-up framing the head and shoulders.","clothing":"A bright pink off-the-shoulder top with dark purple trim and a black-and-pink floral pattern on the shoulder.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, voluminous white hair styled in a swept, textured updo.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin and a neutral-to-smiling expression.","scene":"An outdoor dock or shipyard with weathered wooden planks, a small boat, and stacked lumber in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's side-view full-body shot with a static front-facing medium close-up of the woman's head and shoulders. The first frame closely matches the reference image, and the character performs a similar head-turning and hair-touching motion while remaining in a dock/shipyard environment.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a front-facing close-up of the person's face, using the reference image for initial viewing direction, placement, and framing, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, environment, and timing.
uncertain: Whether the action timing and progression exactly match the source video.
unexpected_changes: The environment changed from the source's open waterfront with a large concrete wall and wooden pilings to a narrower shipyard area with a small boat, stacked lumber, and different background structures.
The outfit appears as an off-the-shoulder pink top with purple trim and floral shoulder pattern, rather than the source's long-sleeved pink top and white skirt.
The framing is a medium close-up of head and shoulders rather than a tight close-up of the face.
